sentences.text:
Challenge in this application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is to the charge sheet dated 1.7.2021 submitted in Case Crime No. 230 of 2022, under Sections 498A, 323 IPC and Sections 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, P.S. Kurawali, District Mainpuri,
Cognizance Taking Order dated 08.04.2022 passed by Civil Judge (Senior Division),
F.T.C./A.C.J.M., Court No. 2, Mainpuri in consequential Criminal Case No. 342 of 2022 (State Vs. Pushpendra and others), arising out of aforementioned case crime number as well as entire proceedings of aforementioned criminal cased, now pending in the Court of Civil Judge (Senior Division), F.T.C./A.C.J.M., Court No. 2, Mainpuri.

entities.text: Dowry Prohibition Act, P.S. Kurawali, District Mainpuri
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Learned counsel for applicants submits that dispute between parties is a matrimonial dispute and in case matter is referred for mediation, parties may get an opportunity to amicably settle their dispute.

He further submits that applicant 1 is husband,
applicant 2 is father-in-law, applicant 3 is mother-in-law and applicant 4 is sister-in-law of opposite party 3 Reena Kumari.
He, therefore, submits that parties may be referred for mediation to the Mediation Centre, High Court, Allahabad.
Accordingly, matter is referred to Mediation & Conciliation Centre of this Court.

Applicants are directed to deposit a sum of Rs. 25,000/- by way of demand draft /pay order in the name of Registrar General A/c, Allahabad High Court Mediation &
Conciliation Centre on or before 20th October, 2022.

entities.text:
Allahabad High Court Mediation &
Conciliation Centre
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: After deposit of aforesaid amount, office shall send a notice to opposite party 3 calling upon her to file counter affidavit.
Out of aforesaid amount, an amount of Rs. 20,000/- shall be payable to opposite party 3 on her appearance before Mediation and Conciliation Centre.

Remaining Rs. 5000/- shall be kept by Allahabad High Court Mediation &
Conciliation Centre for mediation charges.
The Mediation Centre shall submit its report in the matter within three months.

Notice on behalf of opposite party 1 has been accepted by learned A.G.A.
Issue notice to opposite party 2.
All the opposite parties may file their respective counter affidavits on or before the date fixed in the notice.
Put up this case as fresh on 12.1.2023 alongwith report of Mediation Centre.
For the facts and circumstances noted above, as an interim measure, it is provided that no coercive action shall be taken against applicants till the next date of listing.

If the amount, as directed above, is not deposited by applicants within aforesaid period, the stay order shall automatically come to an end and office shall immediately list this case for further orders before Court. "

stating therein that applicant has not complied with the order dated 10.10.2022.
In view of above, present application fails and is liable to be dismissed.
It is accordingly dismissed for want of prosecution.
